notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR6: "A format 2 entry must contain at least one optional clause"; format 2's optional clauses are data-name-1 (SR2 calls it "the data-name clause"), LINE NUMBER and USAGE. ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportEntryFormats, called only when Edition.DialectLevel < 2002, treats an entry below 01 with no PICTURE, no COLUMN and none of the format 3 clauses as format 2 and refuses it (COBOL2247) when it has no data-name, no LINE and no USAGE; 2002 and later drop the rule (REMOVED). Probes (classes b,c): at --std 85 a bare '05.' over a format 3 child is refused COBOL2247 (the witness), as is a second bare '05.' after a legal LINE group; '05 G1.', '05 LINE PLUS 1.', '05 DISPLAY.' and '05 USAGE IS DISPLAY.' each compile and print; '05 FILLER.' is refused both by SR6 and by the edition gate COBOL0900 (FILLER as a report entry name is 2002 syntax); at --std 2023 the bare '05.' compiles and prints HELLO.

next.reason: 1985: "A format 2 entry must contain at least one optional clause."; 2023: "13.15.3 syntax rules (SR-1 to SR-17) state clause order, placement and dependencies; none sets a minimum clause count". 2023 report group entry rules cover the same entries, but no candidate keeps the at-least-one-optional-clause requirement, so a clause-less entry is no longer refused.
